Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + roadmap demo — run order & times

Hi Michael,

Hope you're well — as we get closer to our renewal QBR (target week of June 23), we'd like to lock in a run order and demo cadence so execs and the technical team both get what they need. A few things from our side: 

- We have two execs available the morning of Tue/Thu (PDT) for 45 mins each.
- Our infra/engineering team prefers a separate deep-dive (60–75 mins) later the same day or the following morning.
- We'd like an agenda stub (topics + owners) and any recommended order for demos — e.g., exec overview, performance/cost highlights, then a technical deep-dive.

Can you share:
1) Your preferred run order and whether Redwood can support a split session (exec + tech) on the same day.
2) Two concrete date/time options (including fallback slots) in the week of June 23.
3) Any pre-reads or attachments we should review beforehand.

Thanks — happy to coordinate a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

Best,
Emma
Emma Lopez
Senior Product Ops, Clearwell Health
emma@clearwellhealth.com

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask, this is straightforward. Short answers up front: yes, we recommend a split day (45min exec slot + 60–75min technical lab) and we can accommodate that. 

Proposed run order (attached):
- 0:00–5:00 — Quick welcome + health metrics (you)
- 5:00–25:00 — Exec product highlights (Marissa)
- 25:00–45:00 — Cost & performance summary (Michael)
- 45:00–60:00 — Break / internal handoff
- 60:00–135:00 — Technical deep-dive (Marissa + engineering SMEs)

Concrete date/time options (PDT):
A) Tue, Jun 24 — Exec 10:00–10:45 / Tech 13:00–14:15 (preferred)
B) Thu, Jun 26 — Exec 09:30–10:15 / Tech 14:00–15:15 (fallback)

If those look good I will:
- Share a one-page agenda and split-run playbook (attached: Proposed_RunOrder_v1.pdf, QBR_Playbook.xlsx)
- Send calendar invites with separate guests lists (exec invite will be invite-only; tech session will include your infra SME)

Notes/asks:
- Please confirm whether the execs want to see a 2–3 slide cost breakdown during the exec slot or if they prefer a follow-up memo.
- Do you have a preferred recording policy/consent for the technical session? We can record and redact if needed.

Thanks — looping Marissa to own the agenda and runbook ops.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0182

Options I recommend we present to Emma (keeping availability constraints in mind):
1) Keep Michael's preferred day (Tue 6/24) but: make the tech deep-dive remote-only and record for EMEA; schedule a 15-min follow-up async Q&A with EMEA SMEs the next morning.
2) Move to Thu 6/26 so we can include an EMEA-facing co-presenter live at the end of the tech session (00:60–01:15).

Also, Marissa — can you confirm who from Engineering is available Jun 26 14:00–15:15? If not, propose backups.

Thanks — Priyom
